label.zh: 在候选星系找到那颗恒星（首个40%，或两个都落空后的第二个）
label.en: Find the star in a candidate system (40% at the first, or the second after a miss)

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1023 on_entering_system_fleet → anomaly.4036 (hidden, events/anomaly_events_3.txt:925): a fleet of an owner with the chain enters a system with star flag some_system_1/2; each visit rolls 40% anomaly.4037 (and removes the other candidate) or 60% a miss that adds to the counter systems_visited_poi; when the counter completes (second miss) anomaly.4037 is fired anyway (events/anomaly_events_3.txt:950-1058).

note.zh: 项目完成：按当前能源科技推进下一级（裂变→聚变→冷聚变→反物质→零点），已有零点能则获得每月影响力；事件链结束。
